segments.text: And 98.75% in the first semester, but is expected to improve by the end of the year.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong

DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: At the same time, the PAO was able to improve its performance metrics in 2025 and 2026.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: The PAO was able to achieve high success rates on alternative dispute resolution for the year 2025 at 91.43%.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Across the assessment periods, the agency was also able to act on 100% of petitions for naturalization,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: the high-performance results led to excellent satisfaction ratings from their client agencies.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Similarly, from 2025 up to 2026, the Office of the Government Corporate Counsel, or OGCC,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: was able to file 100% of its pleadings within the prescribed period.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Meanwhile, as of the first semester of this year,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: A significant increase of 8% from its accomplishment rate in 2025.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: In the case of the Land Registration Authority,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: the agency has surpassed its accomplishments in 2025,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: with 93.94% titles issued and 95.67% of deeds annotated within 20 days from receipt of complete documents.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Meanwhile, the Presidential Commission on Good Government,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: reported around $1.57 billion of recovered amount and proceeds

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: The Commission is expected to remit the same amount to the Treasury by the end of this year.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Lastly, the Office of the Alternative Dispute Resolution continuously advances the use of ADR mechanisms,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: having trained 3,392 practitioners and implementers in 2025.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: It has also acted upon all applications for accreditation and approval of ADR training programs for 2025 and 2026.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Overall, the whole Department remains steadfast and optimistic and sustaining,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: if not surpassing its high performance results.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: The total proposed budget of the DOJ, including its constituent and attached agencies for 2027,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: as compared with fiscal year 2026 approved budget of 45.525 billion.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: As you may note, the DOJ budget for 2027 is retained at 0.64 percent or less than 1 percent

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: of the published total NEP budget of 7.2 trillion. Overall, for the FY2027 NEP-based budget,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: 68.32 percent is for personal services, including salaries and other compensation of employees.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Only 24.42 percent is programmed for maintenance and other operating expenses, while 7.26 percent

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: accounts for the capital outlay of select agencies of the department. The slight increase in the

segments.text: Instead of focusing on the religion, let's focus on the problem itself.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hindi po religion ang problema dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Anyway, magko-continue po ako, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nagkaroon po kami ng consultations patungkol sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: budget at may mga ilang mga katutubo

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ang inilapit sa amin ang mga concerns na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Um, may mga reklamo ang ating mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: IPs at ICCs na nagkaroon ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: overlap ng titles kung saan patuloy pa ring

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: nag-i-issue ang LRA ng transfer certificate of titles.

segments.text: lupang may certificate of ancestral domain titles

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: na in-issue na ng NCIP na nirehistro

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Um ano ang konkretong hakbang o programa ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: LRA upang matigil na ang ganitong overlap?

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: With your permission, may I ask Administrator Jerry Sirios to respond?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Magandang hapon po sa inyong lahat, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: LRA ay kamakailan ay nakipag-ugnayan po

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: sa National Commission on Indigenous Peoples

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: sa pangunguna ni Chairperson Catamco, and

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: uh kasama rin nilang nagpunta sa amin nung nakaraang

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: linggo ay ang counterpart nila sa BARMM po.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: I think they have a ministry for indigenous peoples po in the BARMMM region.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: So kami po ay nakikipag-ugnayan ngayon

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: at kami po ay bumabalangkas ng isang memorandum

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: of agreement upang maayos po ang registration

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: ng mga ini-issue na certificate of ancestral domain

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: title and certificate of ancestral land

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: title sa nasasakupang lugar po nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Paano naman po kapag hindi sa BARMM? Other

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: areas that are not in BARMM na nagkakaroon ng problema sa overlapping po?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Opo. Kami rin po ay nakikipag-ugnayan

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: sa, tulad ng nabanggit ko po,

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: NCIP and also sa DENR and

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: sa LMB po upang maiwasan ang overlapping.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Ang LRA through the Registry of Deeds ay

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: ang huli po sa proseso ng ah issuance ng title.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: But ang issuance po ng title ay nanggagaling po sa tatlong tanggapan po.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Una, ang DENR sa pamamagitan ng LMB.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Nag-i-issue po ng patents. Pangalawa, sa DAR

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: po na natigil na rin ngayon ang issuance ng mga emancipation patent and CLOA.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: And pangatlo po yung NCIP tulad ng

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: nabanggit ko kanina po at ang ikaapat ang judicial titling process.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: kung saan dumadaan sa ating mga korte at kami ay dina-direct upang makipag

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: ah makapag-issue ng isang decree at ng titulo.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Pero sa lahat ng proseso po ng pagtitulo, ang LRA po sa

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: pamamagitan ng RD ang huling ahensya po na humahawak sa titulo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sige follow up question po Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mayroon po ba kayong specific program diyan sa LRA para tugunan ang ganitong

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: problema at kung sakaling mayroon, magkano naman po ang allocation ninyo sa NEP?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Sa kasalukuyan po, kami po ay nakikipag-ugnayan tulad ng nabanggit ko. Pero ang solusyon po nito ay ang

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: pagkakaroon po ng mga ah applications, programs na makakatulong upang maiwasan ang overlapping.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Sa kasalukuyan, mayroon po tayong ine-evaluate na public-private partnership, subalit

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: nasa proseso kami ng negotiations. But maliban po

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: dito kami po ay masusing nakikipag-usap na ho sa ibang ahensya upang mailatag

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: po namin yung iba't ibang titles na nai-issue na at malaman kung ano-ano ang mga meron pong overlapping.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Um, aware po kayo sa JAO No. 1?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ano pong definition nitong JAO No. 1?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Iyong pong JAO, naabutan ko po ito.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Ito po ay interagency issuance po.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Patungkol po ito, kung hindi po ako nagkakamali, dito po

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: sa DAR sa DAR kung saan

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: ugnayan para makapag-issue po ng mga

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: titulo ho sa ilalim ng DAR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Okay. Linawin ko lang, ang JAO No. 1 ay ito iyong mga ahensya na involved patungkol sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: pagbibigay ng titulo sa mga lupain. Kasama na diyan ang NCIP, DENR, DAR, at ang alam ko po ay kasama rin ang LRA dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Okay. Now, follow-up question po. Ano po iyong ginagawa ninyo kasalukuyan diyan bilang parte po kayo ng JAO para masiguro na hindi na nagkakaroon ng overlapping dahil itong tatlong ahensya ay hindi nagkakasundo?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Opo. Iyong pong JAO No. 1, lumabas po doon ang NCIP. Nagkaroon po tayo ng panibagong pag-uusap sa ilalim ng leadership ng dati nating kalihim ng Katarungan.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Nagkaroon ho ng ugnayan dito pero hindi ho nagbunga sa panibagong usapin ano ho but sa kasalukuyan tinutuloy po namin ang usapin para magkaroon tayo ng konkretong aksyon o policy regarding po itong overlapping of titles po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Chair, sana nga po magkaroon kayo ng commitment. Kung maaari, ma-commit ninyo rin po ngayon na sana ipagpatuloy

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: natin iyong pag-coordinate dito sa mga ahensyang ito, nang sa gayon, pagdating po diyan sa LRA, wala na po siyang problema.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So anyway, dadako naman po ako kasi may 30 seconds na lang po ako. Dadako ako sa isa pang katanungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Noong July 16, 2026, nakipagpulong po sa inyo si Datu Rolando Anglao ng Manobo Pulangiyon in Bukidnon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ayon sa kanyang pagkaunawa, kayang ilabas ng inyong tanggapan ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: certificate of no overlap o CNO para sa CADT 261 ng Manobo Pulangiyon sa loob ng buwang ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Batid nating malinis na ang lots 1 at 2 at ang tanging hinahabol ng NCIP ay ang maisama ang lot 3 upang mabuo na ang 1,111 ektarya ng kanilang ancestral domain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kaya ba ninyong i-issue ang CNO ngayong buwan?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Ang lilinawin ko lang po, iyong certificate of lot status po, mayroon po kaming dependency rin po sa DENR.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Assuming po na makapagbigay po sa amin ng hinihiling naming mga technical description or records from DENR, maaari po naming mailabas iyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ibig sabihin po, kaya ninyong maibigay ngayong buwan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Okay po. Sige po. At sana nga po, Mr.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Chair ma-providan niyo rin po kami ng update

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: patungkol diyan kasi last ah budget cycle pa po yan namin fina-follow up.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sana nga po ay maka-receive kami.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Anyway, Mr. Chair, maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Reminder lang iyong mga reports po na hinihingi po ni Representative Ismula.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: kindly furnish the committee and her office po of the report po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Next in line from the majority, Representative J.P. Padernos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Magandang hapon po sa inyong lahat sa ating Department of Justice,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: headed by our Secretary Vida, and all attached agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Mr. Chair, magtatanong lang po ako per agency para mas concrete.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: I'll start with the Bureau of Corrections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: I want to discuss yung facility decongestion and regionalization program ng DOJ.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Pangangailangan po kasi ng BUCOR ang humigit kumulang 55 billion para sa regional facilities,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: pero 676 million lang po ang capital outlay nito habang nasa 387% ang overcrowding sa NBP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Maabot ang target na full closure ng NBP by 2028?

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: nabigyan naman po kami ng pondo ng ating gobyerno.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Pag pinagsama-sama, simula ng 2022 hanggang ngayon,

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: sama pa rin yung hopefully maipasa po yung 472 capital outlay for the...

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Pag sinama-sama po yun, more than 5 billion po yun.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: At ang capacity po na mangyayari na madadagdag is 11,390 additional PDL capacity.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: So itong 2025, nadagdagan tayo ng capacity na 1,000.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Alam po namin na hindi po kayang ibigay lahat ang kailangan namin para lang ma-address yung decongestion.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Pero ang maganda pong nangyayari, nire-repair po namin yung mga sira naming kulungan at nakakatulong po.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Ang report po na sinasite nyo is yung last year pa po yan.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: from 350%, ngayon po, 180% na lang ang congestion.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: iniimbitahan namin kayo para makita nyo kung saan na pupunta yung sinusuporta nyo sa amin.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: And surely, we will also look for other ways.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Yung aming property po dito sa New Bilibid Prison,

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: sa Muntinlupa, humihingi po kami ng permission na ipa-lease na.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Kasi po, yung Muntinlupa po, it should be repurposed.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Napaikutan na po kami ng mga first-class subdivision.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: So, ang inisip namin ay gamitin ito for better use para tumakbo ang economy.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: And hopefully, may mga targets kaming ine-expect na kung mapapa-lease namin ito for the next five years, makaka-generate kami ng 8 billion.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: So, yung po, ang ginagawa namin.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Alam po namin na hindi kaya ng ating gobyerno ibigay lahat ang kailangan ng Bucor.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Pero, I think we are doing our best.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: For the past four years, we have already turned around the congestion problem in Bucor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Mr. Chair, napakagandang balita po niyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: So, can you repeat lang, DG Katapang?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: From 387% overcrowding, nasa 187 na lang po?

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Kasi, kailangan po talagang dahan-dahanin ko na ang paglipat.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: So, yung mga napagawa naman natin na outside Metro Manila, doon po sila nililipat.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: So, but overall, sa buong pagsamasamahin lahat yung ating mga kulungan, 204 na lang po ang congestion rate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Mr. Chair, tulad po nang nabanggit ko last year sa ating budget deliberation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: let's keep in mind lang po sana yung mga pamilya na siyempre karamihan naman po ng mga nade-detain is from NCR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: So, sana po hindi sila ma-displace in other parts of the country, especially yung sa Palawan po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Diba, papunta na po doon yung main facility.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Kamakailan po, binigyan po kami ni Governor Umali

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: ng 60 hectares. Doon po namin ililipat yung reception and diagnostic center.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: At yung po rin magiging mga tiga Metro Manila, north of Metro Manila, yung po ang aming target na magiging kulungan nila.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: And then south of Metro Manila, meron po kami tinitignan na property.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Magsaswapping po kami ng isang institusyon.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: May lupa raw sila sa Laguna ng mga 8,000 hectares na hindi naman nila masyadong ginagamit.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: And in exchange, bibigyan po namin sila ng 500 hectares sa Palawan para itayo yung kanilang eskwelahan sa Palawan.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: So, pag nangyari po yun, lahat ng tiga Luzon ay hindi na maililipat sa outside Luzon.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: Yung mga tiga Luzon, sa Luzon ang makakukulong.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: And then lately rin po, yung nakita rin namin na mas marami pa lang tiga Cebu ang mga nakukulong sa Bisaya.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: So, we are also coordinating with the governor, the good governor, na bigyan din po kami ng kulungan doon sa lugar

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: para yung tuloy-tuloy po natin magiging regionalization yung ating mga PDL.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Napansin ko po doon sa report kanina ng ating department, mostly yung kanilang performance indicators,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: but wala po dito yung utilization po ng budget from last year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: So, maybe we can request our department or the DOJ to provide committee the utilization po ng budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: If it is available, please furnish Representative Padernos and a copy to the committee.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Yes, we will furnish, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Your Honor, if I may add lang, doon sa decongestion.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ang isa ho yung nagdadagdag tayo ng facilities, no?

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Basically, ang isa pa rin ho, pinabibilis din natin yung release natin.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Na nagawa na po natin ng medyo maganda na po ang proseso natin.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Lalo na po yung mga may GCTA nating mga...

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Alam naman po natin yung mga kababayan na natin na naligaw ng landas.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Pero lahat naman po may opportunity ng second chance.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Pag naka-comply na ho sila doon sa requirements ng batas, mag-comply sila sa GCTA,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: buong yabang din ho namin pinagmamalaki na ang BUCOR po,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: kakibat ang PAO, kakibat po yung ating PPA,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: So kasama po nito, mas mabilis na po natin na pro-proseso.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Gumamit na rin po tayo dito ng teknolohiya, no?

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: So ngayon yung mga karpeta, wala na ho yung pagala-gala o nawawalang karpeta.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ngayon ho sa BUCOR, lahat po, bago pa lang sila pumasok,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: naka-digitize na ho. May redundancy plan na ho tayo

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kaya po, mas na-anticipate na natin.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: At tumataas din yung pag-asa ng ating mga kapatid na nakakulong

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: na pag ako'y nagbait dito sa loob, makakalaya na ako sa ganitong panahon.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: So, ano ho, dalawang inisyatibo ho,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: padamihin yung regional prisons facility natin

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: at ang isa, pabilisin din yung releases natin dun sa qualified na po.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kasi po, ang ayaw po natin ay yung nakakulong,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: nakakakuha lang ng abogado ang nare-release.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Dahil sila lang yung nakakapag-file ng writ of habeas corpus.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kaya po, sa ngayon ho, updated po yung ating releases.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ang target po ng DOJ diyan ay not a day longer.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Not a day longer if, of course, it's not a perfect system.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We're working on it, we're striving hard para po,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: not a day longer yung ating pong mga kapatid na PDLs.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ito po ang dahilan kaya 180% po.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: As of this time po, pero we're working hard para po

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: makamit natin yung ideal number po para sa ating mga nakakulong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: For my next question is on, with regard to the ano po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: I'd also like to request from the DOJ yung ating vacancies in every department,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: para po malaman natin saan po ba kailangan na lagyan ng,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: ano po yung mga open for applications.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Kasi may plantilya na po yung mga yan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: sayang naman po kung hindi ma-fill up yung ating vacancies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Mayroon po ba tayong brief report on our vacancies?

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We will submit a comprehensive report,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: but as a summary, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: out of the 7,651 authorized plantilya positions

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: for the Office of the Secretary, that's the Department of Justice,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: So, and we would also be happy to report to you na,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: nung nag-start po ng administration na to,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: especially po yung mga presidential appointees,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: we started with a timeline na almost 2 years, yung mga piskal po natin.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Now, with cooperation with DBM and the Office of the President,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: na-shorten na po natin to 4 to 5 months po,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: yung mga piskal po natin, yung mga prosecutor positions.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: And we're also happy to report to this committee

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: that since the start of this administration,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: And ang take-up po nito sa public, maganda po.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Meron po kaming mga posisyon, mga Your Honors,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: So, we're able to recruit, hopefully, the best and the brightest

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: from those in the legal sector so that they join the workforce po

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Gusto ko lang din pong i-discuss yung ating mga petition for review under the DOJ

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: my experience even before when I was practicing, dun po talaga nagkakaroon ng parang patong-patong

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: na kaso. Ano na po bang status doon and paano po na-address ngayon ng ating bagong

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: kalihim itong problema na to po?

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Of course, when I assumed as acting secretary November 11, sometime in this year po, early

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: this year, I issued a department circular. Pag nakita ninyo po yung docket namin, total po iyan ng

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: 27,000 sa Office of the Secretary, petitions for review, starting as old as panahon pa po

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: What I did, I issued the department circular. So commencing po November 12, 2025, all petitions

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: for review filed starting November 12, I have delegated, I've given authority to all the

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: undersecretaries to review them and to ensure na 100% ang clearance rate. Ang nakikita po

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: namin, Your Honors, around 200 per week po yung nagpe-petition for review. So around 800

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ang mandate ko po sa kanila is hopefully we clear everything that goes in starting November

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: 11. Naka-delegate na po sa undersecretaries. Ano naman po ang gagawin ni Secretary ng department

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: for those pending November 11 and prior years. So nag-cut off po kami ng January 1, 2022-November 11, 2025.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: November 11, 2025. Yan po yung nasa opisina ko and I have certain task forces helping me

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: On that, para po ma-resolve siya, ma-resolve siya, different reviewing legal teams po.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: And so far po, from those pending from 2020 to 2025, that's around 16,000. That's around

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: 16,000 po cases. My office has resolved almost 500 na po thus far. But we continue the work.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: For the older ones, yung prior to 2020.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We also have a... We also issued publications to litigants who are parties to those petitions

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: for review and we've asked them, basically, to confirm or not to confirm yung interest

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: sila on those cases yet. And hopefully, by end of this quarter, Your Honors, no? And

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: we will gladly share with the committee how we are moving forward with all these cases.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: This is basically po, ang tawag nga po sa mga practitioner dyan, pag pumasok daw sa DOJ, parang black hole.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Hindi na alam kung ano yung nangyari ng petition for review.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: But we're trying to address this because this is a check and balance mechanism sa mga field offices po natin.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: For everyone's information, we have 250 offices nationwide.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ito po yung city prosecutor's office, provincial prosecutor's office, regional prosecutor's office.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: And also the office of the Secretary of Justice Prosecutorial Service, which is in Padre Faura.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Of all this, the litigant has a remedy going to the Secretary of Justice.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: And we're trying to put up a system here so that we resolve them in time.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: The problem po is, based on time and motion, talaga pong may challenge ang Department of Justice.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: But we cannot naman prohibit filing of these petitions for review.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: It's basically driven din po from the litigants po na nagpa-file ng petitions sa amin.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: But I think, Your Honor, we're in the right direction.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Hopefully, we improve as the months, as the days go by.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Pasadaan ko lang po sa ating Bureau of Immigration naman on the status of our e-gates and modernization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Ang fully operational ngayon sa Naia, Clark, Mactan, Cebu, at Davao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Anong procurement status po nung natitirang units for Phase 1, 1.976 billion,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: May service level agreement po standards ba tayo sa IT providers natin pag nagka-downtime?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: At nakasingil na po ba tayo ng penalties laban sa mga kontraktor?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Mr. Chairman and Congressman Padernos and Honorable Members of the House of Representatives.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Pagdating po sa e-gates po natin, sa Terminal 1 po,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: ang total po currently is 18, 12 para sa arrival, at for departure, 6 na e-gates po.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Para naman po sa T3, ang arrival po, meron pong tatlumpu, or 30.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Sa departure po, tatlumpu rin po, or 30.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: So ang total po sa Terminals 1 and 3 is 78.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa Cebu International—Clark, I'm sorry po—Clark International Airport, meron pong tatlo.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Dito naman po sa Mactan Cebu, tatlong rin po.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Sa Davao International Airport, dalawa po.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: So yun po ang total number po ng e-gates po natin, not only sa T1 and T3, but sa ibang international airports po, sa labas po ng Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: status po nung ating e-gates project,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: yun pong sa Phase 1, na awarded po nung 2025, 1.5 billion po yun.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Continuing po ang aming procurement, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Nakatipid po tayo doon sa intended budget na 1.9 billion, ng 400 million.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa Phase 2 po ng proyekto,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: ang terms of reference po para dito sa Phase 2 ng proyekto, worth 1.3 billion,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The Department of Justice, yung pong listahan po ng mga terms of reference.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa Phase 3, 565 million po yun.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang commitment po namin, at we're on track, na on budget po for 2025, meron po kaming catch-up plan,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: magiging fully obligated na po by November 2026.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Kasama na po dyan yung sa e-gates Phase 1 project.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: At ang Phase 2 po ng e-gates project, worth 1.3 billion, magiging fully obligated na rin po by November.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: As a matter of fact, Your Honor, we have been conducting weekly meetings

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: para po malaman ng ahensya kung ano na po ang status ng ating proyekto.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Pagdating naman po, Your Honor, sa service agreements, meron po tayong service agreements,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: but those are constantly under review.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Kasama po sa service agreements, hinihingi po namin ng commitment sa mapuprovide po dito ng mga kumpanya, Your Honors.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: So okay na po lahat. So kailan po matatapos yung Phase 2?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang Phase 2 po, matatapos po by November 2026. Fully obligated na po yan by that time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: So I'd just like to commend, Mr. Chair, yung efforts po ng ating Bureau of Immigration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: If you notice, ating mga kababayan, mas mabilis na ngayon yung proseso pag nasa airport.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Of course, with their partnership also with...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Sa ano naman po ako, sa PCGG po. Saan po ba ang PCGG?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Mr. Chair, gusto ko lang po sanang itanong. What is the current budget vis-a-vis total remittance of PCGG?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: And with that contribution, they have a specific...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Does PCGG have a specific proposal which will not entail additional funding from Congress?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Mr. Chair, members of the committee, thank you for this opportunity.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Just for historical context, your honors, in the past 40 years, the PCGG has recovered a total amount of 183 billion in cash,

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: And as of now, during the current administration, the PCGG was able to recover

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: 8.3 billion worth of assets. As far as budget is concerned, historically, the budget of

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: the PCGG has always been below 200 million. So, given that we have already, that it has

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: remitted 8.3 billion during the current administration, I would say that the budget of PCGG was really

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Maraming salamat po. Meron pa po kayong maidadagdag?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: We have a bigger budget now, Your Honors, because PCGG will start paying rent for office

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: space. Because before, our office space was free. As one of the conditions, when we sold

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: an asset, which is in front of Mega Mall along EDSA, we sold that for 800 million pesos.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: And the buyer was San Miguel. And they have a building, which we are now occupying, and

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: they gave us a part of the building for occupation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Quick manifestation na lang, Mr. Chair. So, base naman po sa report

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: ng ating DOJ, res ipsa loquitur. The numbers speak for themselves. Case disposition rate

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Ang success rate nila ng prosecution, also 90 plus percent. And lahat po ng ating mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: performance indicators, it would appear na the DOJ is really doing their job and exceeding

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: our expectation. So, with that said, I would like to manifest my full support for the proposed

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: budget. Actually, edit po natin yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: I manifest that not just my full support for the proposed budget of the Department of

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Justice, but also the increase of its budget, especially for the NBI and BI, kasi nakita ko

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: po ang NBI at BI, 33 percent and 27 percent decrease. Meron po ba tayong brief lang na

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: explanation kung bakit po nabawasan ng sobrang taas yung dalawang agencies na yan? But with

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: that said, yun lang po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: I believe this would be relative to the absorptive capacity ng agency. This was, of course, this

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: is the DBM's call, no? But it was assessed by the DBM yung absorptive capacity of the

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: two agencies. That's why we have catch-up plans for 2026, so that they are able to cope

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: with the budget releases for the two respective agencies. But thank you very much, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Thank you, Representative Padernos. And may we direct the ComSec to acknowledge additional

Committee Secretary

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Representative Robert Nazal, Representative Ma. Cristina Talavera-Lopez, Representative Salvador

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Thank you. Next in line to interpellate from the minority, Representative Chel Diokno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Chair Mike, at magandang hapon po sa DOJ family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Sisimulan ko po sa isang letter C. Hindi po ito Chel, kundi corruption ang dapat nating

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: I noticed that there was a recent article attributed to the DOJ.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: which stated that the over 841 million pesos

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: ay naibalik na sa ating treasury from flood control projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Mula sa apat na nasangkot sa flood control cases na naging state witness,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: I think this would refer to Henry Alcantara, former USEC Bernardo, 500 million,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Henry Alcantara, 181 million, Engineer Opulencia, 140 million, and Sally Santos, 20 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Una ko pong tanong kay Secretary Vida, good morning po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Meron bang na-file na mga forfeiture cases against any of these four individuals

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: to ensure na baka naman meron pa silang tinatago na hindi pa nila binibigay

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Actually, kaakibat po ito sa kondisyon nung kanilang pagpasok bilang state witness, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: At sa ngayon nga po, nagagamit sila ngayon ng Office of the Ombudsman

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: sa patuloy na paglilitis ng mga kasong nakasalang ngayon sa Sandiganbayan at sa RTC.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kaya po ang patuloy nilang pagganap dun sa terms and conditions

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: ng kanilang pagiging state witness, ito po ang kabahagi nun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Did you rely just on their word, or did you also

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: coordinate with AMLA, get bank secrecy waivers, and do other checking

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: para masiguro natin na lahat ng sinasabi nilang ibinalik ay yun na po yun?

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ang naging estratehiya po niyan para makita po yung mga commitment nilang amounts,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: tandaan po natin, paalala lang po pala, yung pagiging state witness nila ay case-specific lang ho.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kaya yung kanilang immunity, dun sa kasong yun lang ho.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kaya yung may disclosure sila na sila kesyo ay may kinita dun sa project na yun,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kaya po pag may nadiskubre ang Office of the Ombudsman, ang DOJ, o kung ano mang ahensya,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: na ibang bagay na sila'y sangkot pa rin, hindi ho yun saklaw.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kaya po ang atin po, tinakda po natin yung pagtatalaga nung amount na to,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: nagsimula pa po ito panahon ni Secretary, now Ombudsman, Boying Remulla,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Yung sinabi nyo lang na kayo ay sangkot at kayo ay involved,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: pero yung immunity mo, dun lang sa particular na project na yun.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kaya pag may nakita po tayo, tingin ko ho, protektado ang bayan dito.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Pag may nakita ho tayo sa apat na to, sa kanilang apat na individual,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: na walang disclosure o may tinago sa atin, pwede pa ho natin silang habulin dun.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Of course, iba po yung sa pananaw ng Office of the Ombudsman.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Sa amin po, yung pagiging state witness sila under the Witness Protection Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Doon sa very impressive yung inyong report, lalong-lalo na yung tinatawag ninyong

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: na ngayon na taon na ito, o 2025, ay nasa 90.8%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Do you have a figure for your PSR for graft and corruption cases?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: ang tinututukan ng taong bayan ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Gusto naming malaman kung yung mga graft and corruption cases ba

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: nabibigyan ng top priority ng ating pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Karamihan ba ng mga nasasangkot ay nakakasuhan at nako-convict?

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Opo, opo, Your Honor. We need to disaggregate our data, yung available po sa amin.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: And we will submit to the committee, Your Honors, if you may.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We need to disaggregate yung data namin.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: And of course, this data doesn't involve cases handled by the Office of the Ombudsman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: In fact, I'll go back to that point later.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: But I'm just curious, because in 2022, when Secretary, now Ombudsman, Remulla

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: occupied the Office of Secretary of Justice,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: nabanggit niya na ang conviction rate, hindi po ito PSR, kundi conviction rate,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: In fact, he expressed dismay over it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: your figure of 90% is very impressive,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: but it may give the wrong impression to the public

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: that we have already overcome our issues with convictions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: So, may I know, does the DOJ keep a separate tab on conviction rate aside from PSR?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: The prosecution success rate, mix po ito.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Yung conviction ng kaso, kasama na rin po dito yung tinatawag po na nagkaroon po ng compromise agreement.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: And based on that compromise, nagkaroon pa rin ng hatol yung husgado sa isang particular na kaso.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Pero batid po namin, yung 20%, if I recall it right, that would be more particular po.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Yung frustration po ni Secretary Boying at the time was more in the drug cases.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Yung after po, yung after nung 2022, na lumabas na po yung mga tunay na proseso na kahit fiscal ka o judge ka,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: na nag-dismiss ka ng kaso base sa ebidensya, hindi ka li-labelan na protector ng droga.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Tapos, ang isa pa rin ho, ito po yung pagtataas namin nung antas, yung from probable cause,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: tinaas po ng DOJ, yung antas po ng ebidensya na kailangan natin ngayon,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: yung prima facie evidence with reasonable certainty of conviction.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ang isa pong nakikita naming ehemplo dito ay yung sa, pag nakita po natin yung mga sa United States po,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: ang taas po ng kanilang plea bargaining.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Dahil pag plea bargaining, mas mabilis po ang proseso, mas maliit ang resources ng gobyerno.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: So, dahil matitibay yung kasong fina-file.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: And we see ho the benefit now of our case buildup, Your Honors, with the data we're getting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Tama po ba, Secretary Vida, na pagdating sa prosecutorial success rate,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: hindi po kasama doon sa computation yung mga nadi-dismiss na kaso

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: dahil let's say, hindi dumating yung mga testigo, let's say drug case,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: yung mga pulis na dapat humarap ay hindi humarap,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: kaya nadismiss na agad ang kaso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Is that captured by the PSR?

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We need to check. We will submit, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Kasi the data would seem to be parang...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Kaya ako po tinatanong yung, Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: ay dahil sa experience ko, hindi lang sa drug cases, pati na rin sa corruption cases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Yung isang lusot na ginagamit ng mga corrupt at ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: mga criminal, ay they will influence, intimidate, or purchase the witnesses for the prosecution,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: hindi na sila haharap, at kung hindi naka-capture yan ng PSR,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: then malaking bagay po iyon na hindi natin namo-monitor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: which I think is very important for the DOJ to monitor.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Completely agree with that, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We will do that, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: I think I have a minute and 18 seconds left.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Nabanggit niyo kanina na hindi lang naman ninyo trabaho yung anti-corruption,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: It's also the job of the Office of the Ombudsman, as well as the Anti-Money Laundering Council, among others.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Do you have a coordination committee or anything like that that discusses, for example, budget that all of you need,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: that discusses things that are needed by the government,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: What we have now, our engagement with the Office of the Ombudsman,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: is an existing memorandum of agreement

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: relative to investigation of cases and filing of cases

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: for those salary grade 27 and above

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: for the Office of the Ombudsman and those below

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: to be handled by the Department of Justice.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ang isa pa ho naming engagement with the Office of the Ombudsman now is

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: the possibility of coming up with a code on anti-corruption.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: This would basically be seeing the learnings that we saw in the recent past,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: kung paano natin talaga mas mapapatibay yung mga batas natin on anti-corruption.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We have an ongoing engagement on that.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We have a technical working group, Your Honors,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: on possibly doing work on possible legislation

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: on coming up with a code on anti-corruption, Your Honors.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: So bale, sa kasalukuyan ay ad hoc lang po

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: ang pakikipag-usap ninyo ng AMLA at ng OMB.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Kaya ako tinatanong yan, because way back in, I think it was 2006,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: I was informed, I learned that there was a study made of the corruption cases

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: that went through the Sandiganbayan, at ang nalaman po nila noon

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: ay out of 110 persons convicted of graft and corruption cases,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: sa sampu lang, only 10 were found to have been actually inside the jail serving their sentence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Ito po yung mga convicted of graft and corruption by final judgment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Now, is there, to your knowledge, may I just finish my question, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: To your knowledge, is there any centralized system or database

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: of the government that is there to keep track na kung yung isang tao ay na-convict ng graft and corruption?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Kahit sabihin natin, ibang mga criminal cases, at in-appeal niya yung kanyang conviction,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: later na-affirm yung kanyang conviction, namu-monitor ba natin kung talagang nakukulong yung nakonvict?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Kaya ako po, let me just finish. The reason I ask is because not one agency can keep track of this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Hindi kaya ng DOJ yan, hindi kaya ng Ombudsman, hindi kaya ng NBP or ng ating nasa DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: So, shouldn't there be a consolidated effort by our government?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Because sayang naman yung milyong-milyones na ginagastos niyo pang-prosecute ng isang tao kung hindi naman pala nakukulong?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Yes, I completely agree po. Sa particular directive or legal framework should be brought out

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: so that those... I completely agree, Your Honor. Ang isa po namin, from our end, which I've initiated po,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: we just had a meeting with my regional prosecutors and si PG Dong, is basically to monitor yung mga sinampahan namin ng kaso,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: alin yung mga naka-archive doon, dahil at large yung mga akusado. That's something we can look within the DOJ.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kaya po, nasa poder ko po yun. Pero I completely agree with you, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We need to look at yung mga convictions, kung sino talaga yung nahatulan ng sentensya at nakakulong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Thank you so much, Secretary Vida. Sana kayo po ang maging pambato nitong talagang kinakailangan natin pagdating sa corruption.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Thank you so much, Chair Mike.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Thank you po, Representative Chel Diokno. Next in line from the majority, Representative Brian Poe.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Mr. Chair, I'd like to start with some questions for the NBI.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I want to ask the NBI, if the NBI has any funding for representatives or attaches in embassies abroad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Based on RA 10867, Section 7F, the NBI is allowed to have an attaché or representative.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: However, the funding, according to the law, must come from the NBI.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: I want to ask if in this year's budget, is there an allocation for the NBI?

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Wala po. And I'm very thankful that you raised that issue because that is one of the future plans that the NBI is looking at,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: that we put NBI attachés in at least yung selected po muna na mga areas.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Because dito po sa atin, sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Yung mga embassies from Europe and the U.S. Embassy itself, meron po silang mga counterparts.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: It's been helping us to address transnational crimes.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: So thank you for raising that issue.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: And kasama po sana sa wish list namin iyan na mapalagay po.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: And I'll take advantage also to request because we want to increase the number of agents.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Because if we will comply with that, we need additional agents.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Right now, for the benefit of this committee po and everybody,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: I'd like to tell you that ang NBI agents po namin sa buong Pilipinas is only about 300 persons lang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Mr. Chair, this is quite alarming, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Na our NBI doesn't have funding for any international agents or representatives to be attached to any of our embassies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if I could remind the committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: If I could remind the committee of all the responsibilities of the NBI going after

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: POGOs, scam networks, cyber fraud, online gambling, Interpol cases, human trafficking,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: online sexual exploitation of children, the list goes on.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: And yet we haven't given a single centavo for a single attaché representative abroad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: And I feel that it's something that we should look into as we continue on this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: This deliberation on the appropriations for the Department of Justice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Because, as our colleague here Representative Chel Diokno was saying about accountability and investigation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: how are we supposed to go after international fugitives if we don't even have funding for NBI representatives abroad?

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I feel that this is one thing that we should take into consideration for this budget season.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Next is I'd like to ask about what we're doing for our kababayans who don't have access to legal aid.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: I believe meron tayong, and we were able to fund it last year, I believe, around 8 million pesos more or less

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: for the DOJ Action Center or yung tinatawag natin Katarungan Caravan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Based on my numbers, and correct me if I'm wrong, Mr. Secretary, you're currently at around 15,000 people who have been

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: This is well on its way to surpassing the numbers from last year of 25,000 served.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Basically, this is the access to legal services.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: But of course, the primary agency is the Public Attorney's Office, na nagpapasalamat kami.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Pero nakita po natin kasi yung puwang sa serbisyo.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: At siguro, ang lagi ko hong binibigay niyan—I was interviewed—bakit naging verb yung Tulfo?

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: 'Ipapa-Tulfo kita.' And I give credit to the Tulfo siblings kasi meron pong kulang na serbisyo.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: At ito po yung pilit na pinupunuan. Kabahagi po dito yung DOJ Katarungan Caravan.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Sa atin pong pag-ikot sa buong Pilipinas para ilapit yung serbisyo on legal services sa ating mga kababayan,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: nakita natin na meron talagang puwang na pwedeng punuan.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Pero para ho maging resilient at saka maging permanent po yung sistema ng serbisyo,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: ang plano po natin ay, maliban na lang siya na parang ad hoc o task force, yung DOJ Katarungan Caravan

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: maging permanente ito sa bawat opisina ng DOJ.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ito po yung sa ating 250 prosecutorial offices nationwide na na-establish.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: ang pinipilit po namin ngayon ay mag-set up kami ng protocols on this legal service

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: para po yung bawat opisina sa bawat probinsya, sa bawat city at sa bawat region

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: ay may madudulugan na yung ating mga kababayan. Yung serbisyo,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: yung puwang na iyon na free legal service.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kaya nga po sa pagdedesign namin ng mga opisina ngayon, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: pinipilit namin na kasama natin sa design yung DOJ Action Center

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: or ang gusto nga ho namin sanang matawag ito ay para ho may ownership yung mga kababayan natin

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: ay DOJ Katarungan Office o DOJKO.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kasi sa dulo po itong serbisyong ito sa kababayan naman natin ito

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: para ho mas mapalapit natin yung serbisyo, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: I was asking about this program kasi para sa mga kababayan natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: malaking gastos po to go to their lawyers,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: to go to centers of commerce where they can access legal services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Kaya maganda yung programa ng DOJ and the fact that the DOJ, I believe,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: has opened around nine new Katarungan regional centers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Are we going to be opening more in the years to come?

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Do we have funding for this, Secretary?

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Actually, yung ating optimization plan for the Department of Justice

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: so that it's rather than a secretary-initiated program,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: inilatag na po namin ito sa DBM

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: for the optimization plan for the Department of Justice

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: para may kaukulang plantilya, may kaukulang resources

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: para nga po yung 250 field offices natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Mr. Chair, the reason why I'm bringing this up also is

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: because with such a limited budget of only around 8 million pesos

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: under the office of the Secretary

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: for the Katarungan Caravan and the DOJ Action Center,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: they've been able to help more than 15,000 people as of date now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: They're on track to help more than 25,000 people by the end of the year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Mr. Chair, you realize that per person,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: that means that the government is only,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: spending about 250 to 300 pesos per person for legal assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: The average lawyer would charge you more than 1,000 to 3,000 pesos an hour.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: The government is doing good for the people with such a limited fund.
