segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Okay lang na bumagal ang ating proseso

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: We usually say that the budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So ibig sabihin po ba nito dito sa massive budget cuts na ito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: hindi priority ng gobyerno ang pagliligtas sa mga biktima ng OSAEC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Hindi priority ng gobyerno ang pag-rescue sa lalong madaling panahon

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: sa pinakamabilis na paraan ito pong mga biktima po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nito pong napakalaking, masasabi nating, sindikato

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Earlier you mentioned that now we're not just talking about individuals

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: but we're also talking about how AI is being used.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: how will you be able to respond to this much bigger problem?

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: We need to catch up, sir, on our mechanisms.

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: and nagiging mas complicated yung modus operandi

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: ng mga gumagawa po ng illegal recruitment, for example,

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: na-mention po kanina ni Secretary of Justice

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: iyong groomers behind iyong mga nihilistic violent extremism incidents po.

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: Now we don't even need an actual person conducting the enticement of our youth.

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: It could be an AI agent doing that.

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: And if we don't put in place the foundations of our IT infrastructure

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: for the proper, timely, and commensurate response to the threat,

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: the AI po being used to perpetrate these crimes,

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: And we need to provide for a corresponding response to the threat.

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: So we need to consider yung constantly evolving mechanisms po

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: of how these crimes are being perpetrated.

segments.speaker: DOJ Assistant Secretary Michelle Anne Lapuz
segments.text: For us to be able to be one, two, three steps ahead of the threats.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So hindi lamang po pala yung mga masasamang elementong ito ang threat

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: sa kaligtasan ng ating mga kabataan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Yung mismo pong budget na pinutol at tinanggal

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: is also a threat to the safety of our children.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Again, we support you in restoring your budget to the 2026 levels.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And kahit po kami ay bahagi ng minority, kasama niyo po kami.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: We support your advocacy para po sa lalong madaling panahon ma-restore to 2026 levels.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Deserve po ng ating mga bata na maprotektahan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At yung mga nasa peligro na po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: deserve na deserve nila ang immediate rescue at assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Mr. Chair, let me direct my next set of questions to the Bureau of Immigration.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ito po ay tungkol po sa usapin ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nung mga paggamit ng blacklist at entry restrictions as a political tool.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nakita po natin yan noong nakaraang administrasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ginamit itong mga blacklist at entry restrictions laban sa mga advocates,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: laban sa mga aktibista, at laban sa mismong kinatawan ng United Nations

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ginamit ito in aid of violence and impunity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Noong 2026 po, sinabi ng Amnesty International Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: nananatiling mayroong entry ban si Amnesty International Secretary General Agnès Callamard

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: as a result of her previous work as, again, UN Special Rapporteur on Extrajudicial Killings.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nagsimula po ang ban na ito noong 2018, bunga ng public attack ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kaya mahalaga pong malaman natin meron po bang sapat na safeguards ang BI

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: upang matiyak na hindi ito nagagamit arbitrarily, hindi ito naweweaponize,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: at para po tiyakin na hindi ito ginagamit laban sa human rights work and peaceful advocacy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: The first question, Mr. Chair: maaari po bang kumpirmahin ng BI ang kasalukuyang status ng entry restriction kay Ms. Agnès Callamard?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: If I may confirm with my colleague, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Your Honors, ang lahat po ng desisyon ng Bureau of Immigration ay dumaan po sa proseso, unang-una.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang information po na nakalap namin ay hindi lang po galing sa vetting na ginawa ng Bureau of Immigration,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: but galing po sa ibang mga ahensya,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: We refer to Interpol lists, we refer to fugitive status of individuals bago po kami umaksyon.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: And internally, Your Honor, bago po kami mag-issue ng any blacklist, dumadaan po iyan sa proseso

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: kung saan ang legal division, ang amin hong mga abogado sa legal division,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: and eventually iyong mga Board of Special Inquiry at Board of Commissioners.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Dinadaanan po iyan ng hindi lang maikling proseso pero mahaba-haba po, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: So we can assure po, Your Honors, na any decision, any order concerning any blacklist

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: ay dumaan po sa tamang proseso at legal na pamamaraan po, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: at the behest of any individual. Ito po ay ginagawa po sa level po ng aming bureau.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So the question again, Mr. Chair, ano po ang status ng entry restriction kay Ms. Agnès Callamard?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Again po, si Ms. Agnès Callamard po, sigurado ako wala po iyan sa blacklist ng Interpol.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: She is former United Nations Special Rapporteur on Extrajudicial Killings.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: We are confirming po iyong status ni Special Rapporteur Callamard.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: But kung base po dito sa information po na nakalap namin ngayon, galing po dito sa honorable body na ito,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: we are willing to also review the status of the Special Rapporteur.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Because we are in favor of human rights, we are in favor of other persons from other countries coming into our country

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: and to see how we have gone forward as far as human rights are concerned, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Mr. Chair, thank you very much, Commissioner Viado, for that response.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And we welcome your willingness to review your guidelines, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Lalo na po pagdating sa mga human rights defenders, international advocates, journalists,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa proseso po noong pag-review, inaasahan po natin na hindi na ito magagamit as a political weapon

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: against voices of dissent, against voices of human rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nagawa na po ito noong madilim na panahon ng Rehimen Duterte, huwag na po nating hayaang maulit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: That will be all, Mr. Chair. Marami pong salamat sa DOJ family.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Thank you rin po, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Next in line from the majority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: Ann Matibag. Thank you. Um, I just want to interject also,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: no, after what my good friend Cong. Perci

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: has conveyed, especially to the OSAEC cases. We are really disheartened on

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: what happened with the deduction of your budget, and

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: with the OSAEC cases, we were more surprised

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: that much in the Department, 'yung mga law enforcement pa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: 'yung mas nabawasan din, no, like the Bureau of Immigration and the National

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: Bureau of Investigation. So I just want to commend Mr.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: Chair, Secretary Vida, and your whole team.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: We were in New York, in the United Nations, last March. I am with Usec. Majken Anika, and

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: I want to commend their program, which is the Revised CANE+D

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: Protocol, which is intended to provide a more standardized and coordinated

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: way of handling cases such as this of violence against women and children.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: So this emphasizes the clarity on the responsibilities of the agencies involved,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: coordinating among them, and a more child-sensitive approach to investigation

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: and prosecution. So this is not just a policy in paper. I just want to

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: tell—and I'm just so proud of this program of the Department

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: of Justice—and this has already begun

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: bringing the Revised Protocol to the local level. I remember when

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: my group, my social organization, Zonta Club of Laguna,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: went to the office of Secretary Vida, and he was very happy to tell us that

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: this is not just laws. This is not just a memorandum or any piece of paper or

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: a policy, but they already launched nationally in August

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: 2025, followed by the provincial implementation in Cavite in

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: March 2026 and in Cebu in July 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: So for me, this is exactly the kind of program that deserves support in the

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: 2027 budget, especially I'm the chairperson of the Committee on Women and Gender

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: Equality, and I'm with Cong. Sarah Elago and Cong. Perci,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: who are members of my committee. Rest assured that I just want to manifest my

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: support, that we will make sure that your budget will not only be increased,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: but with what you wish and hope for to have, especially to the department

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: of the wife of Cong. Keith—she's the director—so we

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: are in support of that. And maybe before the plenary session, we can

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: huddle and think things together, and maybe discuss on

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: and discuss this budget that we need to really

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: bring it back to the DOJ's wish. And I am very happy to

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: see everyone here. DOJ, special po kayo dahil

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: ako'y pinalaki ng isang fiscal—ang tatay ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: Especially now that NBI here is very,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: very responsive to the needs of being a law enforcement for women and children.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: So, maraming-maraming salamat po. You have my support and respect. Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Cong. Ann Matibag, sa suporta po sa ating pong ahensya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Next in line from the minority, Representative Leila de Lima.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: And good afternoon to Secretary Vida and the DOJ family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Let me start by manifesting not only my support for the budget, the department-wide budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: of the DOJ, but also support for the push for the restoration of some of the areas of

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: some of the budget that was cut, including the ones for OSAEC and also

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: for IACAT. And we do note very much the significant cuts, of course, in the

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: DOJ-wide budget, a 61.82% cut, and then the biggest among the agencies is the

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Bucor by 84.18% cut. I'm talking about the NEP as against the proposed budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: and then also NBI as 65.84%. So ang gusto ko pong i-ano ngayon, lalo na dyan sa Bucor and sa NBI, if you wish to

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: insist about or for more in your wish list for increase in the budget, please

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: But specific items in the budget for Bucor, for DOJ, for NBI, and even the

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: others, OSG and even PAO, so that we can help you out, at least put back the

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: priority, your priority programs that were actually cut in the NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Now, I wish to direct my questions first to BI.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: then to Bucor and the DOJ proper.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: I would wish also to pursue further the case of Dr. Calamard.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: It struck me what you said, that it was not at any behest when you make any blacklisting.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Sa case ho ba ni Dr. Callamard, ganoon? It was at no one’s behest.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: As far as I know, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: What was the legal basis for the blacklisting of Dr. Calamard?

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Your Honor, based on the record, it was a national security concern, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Do you have any specific explanation for that?

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: There was no crime committed, correct?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: As far as I know, Your Honor, no.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: And there was no immigration violation?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: But what you are saying now is a national security threat.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: But isn’t she the one who investigated the drug-war killings as the former UN Special Rapporteur on extrajudicial killings?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: That is based on the records available, Your Honor, to us at the moment, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: I can dig deeper into this matter, Your Honor, because this matter, I think, was...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: occurred even before we came into, you know, we were appointed to the Bureau of Immigration.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: So hanggang ngayon po, hindi ninyo talaga alam exactly kung anong naging basehan?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang basehan po is based on reports from a national security agency, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: But I can give you the details and the other facts and issues concerning this matter.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: If you can give us a chance, Your Honor, we can give you a full detailed report on that matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Hindi ho ba merong motion for reconsideration with respect to that?

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: As far back as August 2026, there is this motion for reconsideration on the blacklisting of Dr. Calamard.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: For the lifting, for the lifting of the blacklist.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: And isn’t it that under the BI Omnibus Rules, the commissioner is supposed to resolve a lifting petition within 15 working days?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Bakit napakatagal na iyong ginagawa ninyong review about the case of Dr. Callamard?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Your Honor, as far as I know, there is no pending matter involving this.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: But once we get back to the office, Your Honor, we will act on it right away.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: How soon can we expect that?

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Because this is, you know, this matter is being monitored, actually, by certain UN officials.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor. We understand, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: We will act on it right away by tomorrow, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Okay. Doon naman po sa CAIS.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: May pino-propose kayong additional P480 fee.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Bago ho ninyo na-propose itong fee na ito, was there any alternative funding source being considered?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Considering, Your Honor, that this is a public-private partnership program, Your Honor, there was no alternative discussed.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: This is an unsolicited proposal which came from a private proponent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: Yes. So why should—I mean, I’m just wondering—why should the cost of modernizing immigration infrastructure be passed on to the traveling public, even if it’s covered by a PPP?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Your Honor, first and foremost, we need a more integrative program which covers

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: a border security platform with biometrics, advanced analytics, and passenger information system, actually, to enhance national security and immigration control, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: At the moment, there is no particular program which can be funded by the national government at this level.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The private proponent proposes to put the capitalization in the amount of 10.7 billion for the next five years.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: And with the constant upgrade of the system every four years

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: for the next 20-year period, Your Honor, at no cost to the government.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: At no cost to the government.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: At no cost to the government, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: But you’re still insisting on the P480 fee, because that is what is being demanded.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Actually, Your Honor, it is P240 per ticket.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: So if it’s a round-trip ticket, Your Honor, it’s P480.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Compared to other countries, this is way below.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: This is actually the practice in other countries.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The US, Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan have been doing this at costs which is much higher than what we are proposing.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: As a matter of fact, Your Honor, if you can compare, Australia charges about 2,600 pesos per passenger.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: And Thailand charges about 1,800, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Leila M. de Lima
segments.text: The imposition of that fee would stay?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: It is still under review, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The contract is still under review, yes.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado

segments.text: Good afternoon to my distinguished colleagues and our valued resource persons this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So I am here because I am here to support the budget of the OSEC and all the departments

segments.text: and attached agencies of the Department of Justice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I finished my undergraduate studies in De La Salle because I was able to get the salary of my father,

segments.text: who was for 20 years provincial fiscal of Misamis Oriental.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And I would go to the, you know, La Salle, and then we go by jeepney to Padre Faura and get it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: My life, therefore, has a history of support from the Department of Justice,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: and we can never, our family can never forget that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So first questions will be—these questions are leading questions—

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: To increase the budget of the OSEC.

segments.text: The OSEC, while it looks like there is an increase,

segments.text: however, your MOOE has been reduced from 1.9 to only 1.6,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: million decrease. What is your wish on this, Mr. Secretary?

segments.text: Your Honor, to meet the levels of 2026, to be restored to that level,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: so that the department would have sufficient resources to fulfill its mandate, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So we will work on that in the BARC, in our Committee of Vice Chairpersons,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: and then hopefully in the BICAM.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: from the proposed budget for the Office of the Cybercrime,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: which we do not want to lose the momentum that we have now, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: How much for the three agencies?

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Similarly, Your Honor, to be restored to the levels of 2026.

segments.text: Take note, because we're going to work for this.

segments.text: Please, please note down, because we’re going to make sure that it will be restored.

segments.text: on their pursuit and in the particular challenge in addressing cybercrime

segments.text: in pursuit of their investigation and their push

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: so that the requested budget from the DBM be restored on the ICT projects and programs.

segments.text: Yes, good that you've mentioned, because I'm going to go one by one,

segments.text: And we're going now to NBI, because mentioned already.

segments.text: is it correct that your agency,

segments.text: which has already been obligated by this time, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So assuming, because we will assume that you will do it.

segments.text: Can you place here a restoration of 880?

segments.text: It will not be counted against my time.

segments.text: Our agents right now is getting a hazard pay of only 4,000 pesos monthly.

segments.text: So we are requesting at least we can be leveled with the other law enforcements,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: which is probably the reasonable amount will be 15,000 monthly for them to operate properly,

segments.text: our agents has been transferred from one province to another,

segments.text: and they’ve been operating 24/7, like the concern on the issue of OSAEC.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: So I'm respectfully requesting that the hazard pay of our agents from 4,000 be increased to 15,000 at least.

Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
segments.text: So around maybe 800 million to 1 billion pesos din po yun.

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
segments.text: And then, ang hiningi lang po namin ay dahil through the MYCA,

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
segments.text: so 255 million will go to the first year installment to be paid to GSIS.

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
segments.text: First year. So iyon po iyong nakalagay sa NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Has the DBM approved your MYCA proposal?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Because if it is there, every year we'll be able to put a budget.

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
segments.text: Yes, ang nailagay po ng DBM dahil ang timeline po namin,

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
segments.text: six months pa to kung makonfirm, then mafifit out po yung building.

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
segments.text: Ang nawala po yung sa computerization, sa digital transformation program po yung 100 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Very important. How much is that?

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Computerization, we need that very much.

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Plus the building, 250 for the year, next year.

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
segments.text: Iyong pong building, nandoon na po iyon sa NEP.

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
segments.text: So ang medyo inihihirit po yung...

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
segments.text: na-exclude po, gawa ng isiningit po yung sa building.

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Our solicitor general, who is doing a very good job in the Supreme Court of the Republic of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
segments.text: Na-iraos na po natin ang GAA oral argument sa Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: Solicitor General Darlene Marie B. Berberabe
Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And we have the office of the ADR reduced also.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Very small part, reduced pa. Where is the OADR head?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Well, you are like some other official saying, I just scolded the CDA representative in that hearing just recently

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Because he said, he said, this budget will do.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: He will agree to the small budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: He will never say that in a budget hearing that we will make do with the budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: You fight always so that you will have an increase in your budget.

segments.speaker: OADR Executive Director Jose Maria Palaganas
OADR Executive Director Jose Maria Palaganas
OADR Executive Director Jose Maria Palaganas
segments.text: We would like to propose restoring it to the original 168 million for 2027.

segments.speaker: OADR Executive Director Jose Maria Palaganas
OADR Executive Director Jose Maria Palaganas
Office of the Government Corporate Counsel representative
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, we will defer to the judgment of the DBM, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: You never defer to the judgment.

segments.speaker: Office of the Government Corporate Counsel representative
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, we have an optimization plan that we presented to the DBM and we hope they will...

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, we will work also for you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And then, my second-to-the-last question is the Parole and Probation Administration.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, are you thanking the DBM for that?

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: We are requesting more for next year.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
segments.text: But hopefully, this budget will not anymore be touched.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: It will never be reduced, but it will be increased.

segments.speaker: BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio P. Catapang Jr.
Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: How about the Parole and Probation Administration?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So I have a wrong addressee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So I have some letter for you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So the parole probation, again, was reduced by 49 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So what are the important items to be restored?

segments.speaker: Parole and Probation Administration representative
segments.text: In our case, we were reduced by 49 million,

segments.speaker: Parole and Probation Administration representative
segments.text: pero po kasi intact na po kami sa ISSP computerization namin.

segments.speaker: Parole and Probation Administration representative
segments.text: Ang wish list po namin ay para sa probation officers’ ladderized

segments.speaker: Parole and Probation Administration representative
segments.text: three-year improvement program for their major competencies po.

segments.speaker: Parole and Probation Administration representative
segments.text: This is about 8,198,000 for a three-year period.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So we'll try to work on that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Because I think I called everybody already.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Lahat naman yata nakuha na, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Well, you have an increase here.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: But what is the wish of PCGG?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson
segments.text: Ang wish po namin, eto talagang wish po, is more institutional rather than budgetary.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson
segments.text: So our wish is that the mandate of the PCGG will be expanded, but this requires a law po kasi.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson
segments.text: Because presently po, our mandate is limited.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson
segments.text: It's limited to a few individuals only.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson
segments.text: And so we would like to expand sana yung mandate ng PCGG to include all public officials.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson
segments.text: Mandate namin is to file civil forfeiture cases.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson
segments.text: So as far as corruption is concerned, that is the template that has been used by the PCGG for the past 40 years.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson
segments.text: And we were able to recover more than 300 billion only through civil forfeiture.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson
segments.text: Wala po kaming naipakulong, pero we were able to recover that much.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson
segments.text: And so gusto po sana namin ma-expand yung mandate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Perhaps we can now give way to a new mandate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I understand there's already a bill for that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So I will be a co-author.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: For that, so that you will be able to expand your powers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: With that, Mr. Chairman, I thank you for being lenient with me.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I congratulate Secretary Vida for an outstanding performance as Secretary of Justice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And all of our attached agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Again, you have our support here in Congress.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: For after all, justice is an important component of a democracy and development of our nation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman, for your leniency in my time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Thank you for emphasizing the needs of the DOJ and its attached agencies

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: para po mas maganda pa po yung operations na magawa po nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Next in line from the minority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Good afternoon, Secretary Vida and the DOJ family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: We in the minority strongly supports the promises of Congressman Rufus.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: And I think we can assure fiscal space by reducing the appropriations of the House of Representatives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Ang first question ko po, Secretary, para po sa ating immigration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: And this is about the CAIS, the Civil Aviation Immigration Security Services Project.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: I would like to maybe appraise of what's the status of the project na.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The current status, Your Honor, po, it is under contract review.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: And the final screening will be made by the Department of Finance, the OSG, and the PPP Center, po, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: But the contract was already signed?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: No contract has been signed, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So can you just brief us on what's in particular is the contract?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: This is a build, train, maintain, transfer modality?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Build, train, maintain, and transfer modality, it is a public-private partnership proposed

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: by SIGRIPORT and delivers an integrated aviation and border security platform.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: When you say, Your Honor, advanced analytics, kahit po yung behavior ng isang tao at the

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: point wherein kinukuha yung information regarding him, any nervous stick, any facial contortion

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: can be read by the system to determine kung high risk po siya at malaking probability

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: that he will cause havoc when entering the Philippines.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: And it also integrates passenger information systems with the ultimate objective of enhancing

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The features of this program include access to billions of facial images.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Yung categorization po and then risk scoring, meaning kaya po na nabanggit ko kanina, kung

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: high risk po yung pasahero na lagi intend na pumasok ng Pilipinas, then ma-analyze po

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: at mabibigyan po ng proper tool ang aming immigration officer to decide whether or not

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: to allow this person to enter.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Meron din pong biographic comparison against criminal and sanctions databases, meaning

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: ang interpol po, may access po tayo dyan sa kanilang...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: system, not only sa Central, but all 194 countries sa konektado po sa Interpol.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Meron din pong deception detection analytics based on mga nabanggit ko po, involuntary

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: And nandyan din po ang AI-assisted open source intelligence, meaning kung nagkataon po na

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: let's say 15, 20 years ago, on Facebook, meron po kayong nasabi, which would

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: be the system would read as amounting to or gearing towards terrorism.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Mababasa rin po yan, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang target po nito, Your Honor, is to increase, expand the borders, meaning hindi na lang po

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: border natin o physical border po ng Pilipinas ang babantayan.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Na-expand po natin yan pagating sa ibang bansa.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ngayon po, kung ang isang pasahero nagsusubok pumunta ng Pilipinas, based po sa...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: pagkuhan niya ng ticket, pagkuhan niya ng kanyang passenger reference number, mariread

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: po ito, and then even before boarding ng aeroplano, kung sa tingin po ng sistema na hindi po siya

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: dapat sumakay o pumasok ng Pilipinas, ibabato po yung information na po na yun in real time

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: sa immigration officers po natin dito sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: down to the benefit of the airlines, kasi hindi na po sila gagastos para pabalikin pa po ang isang tao

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: na hindi naman po pa papasukin dito sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: So, yan po ang features po.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: And then, Your Honor, we also have to take into account that the system being resorted to,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: or systems being resorted to, schemes, if I may call it that, resorted to by terrorists, criminals, are ever evolving.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: So, itong sistema po na ito...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: aims to combat, or help, or be a tool to help our immigration officers in combating human trafficking,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: smuggling, drug and weapon smuggling, terrorism, money laundering, tax evasion, and organized crime.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Yan po. Yan po yung sistema, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Ano na-propose po yung Secure Reports Limited?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: That's correct, Your Honor. Secure Reports Limited.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Sino pong mayari nito? Porin or Pilipino?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ano po? Ang Secure Report po is a company incorporated in the United States.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: It's way back in 2000. Hindi po Philippine Corporation po yan.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Two years in the making na po, Your Honor, ang pag-review po ng iba't-iba ahensya ng gobyerno dito sa proposal po nila.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: It went through the PPP Center, it went to the DOJ, it went through the Bureau of Immigration.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: So, dalawang taon na po, Your Honor, na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Your Honor, a sovereign company will have an access to the data of...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Your Honor, a sovereign function at control po dito sa datos po na ito is retained by the Philippine government.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Tayo po may control dyan, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: They only provide the tools and teach our people how to operate those.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Initially, they will be accessing these datas.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: They will help provide the tools...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: As far as I know, Your Honor, no.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: They will not have control over the data.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: They will have no control over the data, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Because I filed a resolution to investigate this particular contract.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Kasi po, diba, yung tinanggal nga ng gobyerno, yung tinatanggal ngayon ng gobyerno, yung...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, parang ano, parang yung policy decision ng presidente ay tanggalan ng bawasan yung gastos ng mga pasahero.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Your Honor, ito po kasi, hindi po ito form ng tax, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Yes, but that's the function of government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: That's why we are collecting taxes, diba, from our people to provide services.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, ang concern ko po dito, parang magkakontra yung policy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: In fact, dito po sa travel tax, exempted na yung mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, yung mga OFWs natin na nagdadala ng dolyar dito sa ating bansa, dadagdagan pa natin ng gastos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Samantalang, yung revenue na nare-raise natin sa kanila, eh, pwede nating gastosin for this purpose.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: We understand, Your Honor, and we fully agree po with your position.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: As I've stated, this is a secure...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Service fee po ito, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Meaning, hindi po namin pwede ipasa sa madlang bayan, taong bayan, sa ordinary taxpayer po, ang pag-gastos po dito.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang gagastos po dito ay ang mga taong nagka-travel.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Your Honor, admittedly po, sa kanila po, ang mga...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang mga pung-ticket, isasama po ang gastosin dito.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Your Honor, but if I may continue, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Your Honor, ang gastosin po pagdating sa ticket, hindi po sinasagot po yan ng OFWs.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Sagot po yan ng mga employers nila.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang employers po, under an executive order, and under various agreements with other countries,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: ang sumasagot po yan ng gastosin po sa pamasahe, at including na po, kung sakali ma-approvean po ito,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: yung service fee po na ito, ay sasagotin ng...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: So hindi OFWs po natin ang sasagot.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ito po yung mga kumpanyang kukuha po sa kanila ang sasagot dito.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: And if I may, Your Honor, ito pong sistema po na ito, ginagamit na po yan worldwide.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Hindi lang po natin siguro napapansin, pero ang ibang bansa po, nilalagay po yan, nakasama ng gastosin sa mga ticket po.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: As I've stated earlier, Your Honor, ang Australia po, charges about 2,600...

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Sir, you said Hong Kong is doing this.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: I've been traveling to Hong Kong for quite some time, pero wala akong nakikita ng gano'n.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Baka po sa breakdown, makikita po natin, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Yan po, Hong Kong charges 1,800, Japan charges 1,200, Singapore charges 2,400, Australia charges 2,600.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: We charge 240 pesos. So ganyan po yung comparison po, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Your Honor, for the first five years po yan, 10.7 billion, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: But ang security report po promised a technology maintenance upgrade po.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Upgrade not only of the systems, but also of the training for people every four years over the 20-year period.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang commitment po nila is during the lifetime of the...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The agreement sa 20 years po na yan, ganyan lang po naka napag-usapan po namin na charges nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Ano po ang capex nila for the whole project?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: For the whole project po, over the 20-year period, so 10.7 initially, additional, I think, 52.5 billion over the 20-year period po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: It is in the proposed contract?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: It is. Everything is under the proposed contract and under review by all pertinent government agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: The total estimated collection is about 202 billion.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: And the share of the private corporation is 192 billion.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang breakdown po, if I may, Your Honor, is per kada apat na dolyar po, 380 goes to the proponent, 20 cents goes to the Philippine government.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: 95% of the collections will go to the private.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Sir, why are you still giving this to the government?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: This is your service, immigration, to our people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Why are you still giving this to the government?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: It will fund the projects of the Bureau of Immigration.

segments.text: Because, Administrator, there are thousands of unclaimed free patents before the Registry of Deeds all over the Philippines.

segments.text: Yes, Your Honor, you are correct.

segments.text: We have made that observation in our visits to the different Registers of Deeds.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: We have observed several, if not thousands, of unregistered patents previously.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: This was covered by an agreement with the DENR, which paid for the registration of the patents.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: So, perhaps with the approval of the DBM, we can utilize it in registering some of these, or all the remaining patents issued.

segments.text: To be taken from the special account?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Your Honour, under PD 1529, the function of the main function of the Registers of Deeds is the main repository of all the

segments.text: destroyed, or rendered unusable by deterioration?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Your Honor, under PD 1529, the RDs are obliged to conduct an inventory annually.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: I would suppose that would also include all titles, whether it has been lost or damaged in their custody.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: In case of lost administrator of title, who has the legal responsibility for judicial reconstitution?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Your Honor, unfortunately, when the title is lost, the RD copy is lost.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Under RA 26, as amended by RA 6732,

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: the responsibility is given to the owner of the title.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: The responsibility was taken away from the RD.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Previously, the RD was allowed to initiate reconstitution cases,

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: but because of the passage of the law and because of a Supreme Court decision involving the RD of Malabon or Mandaluyong,

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: the Supreme Court said that the RDs cannot undertake the filing.

segments.text: Sir Administrator, is there no exception to the rule under RA 6732?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Under RA 26, as amended by RA 6732,

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: administrative reconstitution can be undertaken by the LRA

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: if the Administrator has evaluated that at least 10% of the titles in the RD has been lost,

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: But in no case should it be less than 500 titles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: As you mentioned earlier, Mr. Administrator, you said the Registry of Deeds are required or mandated to have an inventory of lost titles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: So based on the submission, did the Registry of Deeds make the submission?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: They are required to conduct an inventory which should also include all lost titles.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Some of the RDs have complied with the provisions of the law, and we are closely monitoring also the other RDs, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: Let's say in case the administrative threshold is not met, what can your office do to assist those lost titles, individual lost titles,

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: Loss was in the Registry of Deeds, am I not correct?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Your Honor, it is quite unfortunate that the burden is given to the registered owner in undertaking the registration or reconstitution of lost titles.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: And on our part, what we can do is only provide them with the assistance of providing some of the necessary documents that they will need

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: in filing the appropriate constitution case with the courts, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: In case of loss of Friar Lands or has been lost or destroyed, and the DNR issued subsequent deed of conveyance,

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: what will happen to the registration of the deed of conveyance before the Registry of Deeds?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Thank you, Your Honor, for bringing it up.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: We have several Friar Lands across the country.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: We have the OCDC, which is supposedly in the custody of the Registers of Deeds.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: And the owner's copy is supposedly with the LMB.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: It is unfortunate that some of the RDs have been destroyed or damaged, which included the titles also.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: And it is also unfortunate that LMB has also been burned.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Their head office in Binondo was burned.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: So they have also lost some of the owner's copies of these titles.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: But I would like to inform Your Honor that we are currently talking to the LMB,

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: since they have lifted the moratorium on the issuance of deeds of conveyance,

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: to explore administrative remedies so that we can also help the awardees or claimants of these Friar Lands.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: What administrative remedies you are referring to on the part of the DNR?

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: We will still be discussing with the LMB, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: In fact, we were supposed to have a meeting last week, but because of the weather, it did not permit it.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: But we will be meeting with them soon.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: Perhaps, Your Honor, also with your help, you can also talk to the LMB to meet with us soon on this matter.

segments.text: I think the DNR is scheduled.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: We will have a budget hearing on Wednesday.

segments.text: Maybe, Administrator, if you can commit to us that you can be present here on Wednesday in the afternoon.

segments.text: Okay, I will have my third round.

segments.text: po. So that is the problem right now. What should have happened was, when they subdivided the Friar Lands, it should have been totally cancelled already—wala na hong naiiwan—and

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: the remaining lots that have not yet been awarded should have been issued titles in the name of the Republic para mas

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: madali po. What happened right now is that there is partial

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: cancellation. So it leaves us with portions of the Friar Land na wala pong titles.

segments.speaker: LRA Administrator Gerardo P. Sirios
segments.text: So iyon po ang aming dilemma ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: Registries of Deeds, or what provinces, have Friar Lands problems?

segments.text: As far as I recall, Your Honor, the RDs in Cavite—I think there are four Friar Lands in Cavite—and also the RD in Cebu Province. There's

segments.text: also one particular RD which I'm aware of where the copy of the OCT has been lost.
